items.title: Zay Jones: Joining forces with Texans
items.description:
Jones is signing a contract with the Texans after completing a tryout with the team Friday, Mike Garafolo of NFL Network reports.

items.title: Terrance Ferguson: Seeing expanded route tree in camp
items.description:
The Rams have expanded Ferguson's route tree this summer now that he's more comfortable with the playbook in his second season, Nate Atkins of The Athletic reports.

items.title: Jake Bobo: Knee injury believed to be serious
items.description:
Coach Mike Macdonald said Bobo sustained a "serious" knee injury in Friday's joint practice with the Titans, Adam Schefter of ESPN reports.
